entities.summary: Duane Eddy Washington Jr. is an American-German professional basketball player for Partizan Belgrade of the Basketball League of Serbia (KLS), the ABA League and the EuroLeague. He is the son of former NBA player Duane Washington, he played college basketball for the Ohio State Buckeyes.
